title: Support iMessage file attachments
body: Add validated local attachments to the existing draft-review-confirm-send workflow so a user can send the generated Portugal HTML guide through Messages without uploading it elsewhere.

log.text: Architect wrote implementation, testing, and evaluation plans; commissioned terminal UX design; and required user review before implementation.
Text message submitted; raw HTML and ZIP attachments were rejected by Messages. Final updated PDF draft is ready and awaiting explicit confirmation before send.

Accepted amendment a1 after verifying direct source-path sending in the prototype and compiling the alias-before-tell argv script; plans now require retained confirmed-send staging under a configurable private Messages root.

Design stage is complete; amendment a1 is resolved; implementation gate is open. Plans require private retained Messages-root staging, aliases outside the tell block, argv-only AppleScript, ordered sends with a 0.5-second delay, and immutable snapshot/hash integrity.
Scrubbed email-shaped test examples and plan defect history to non-address placeholders, reran focused tests and privacy scans successfully, and finalized plan p-20260823-6e719b.
Implemented and independently verified confirmation-gated iMessage file attachments with Messages-sandbox staging; live PDF submission accepted by Messages.
